Requirements: R-12
Plan row: TS-7

Obligations: OB-9.

## Given
- Source project with integrations I1 and I2. Datasource D1 in the source uses I1 (setting_id = I1); control datasource D2 in the source uses I2.
- A target project the user administers.

## When
1. Move I1 to the target by PUT with project_name = target.
2. GET D1 and D2; GET I1 in the target.

## Then
1. P-linked: D1 has its setting_id cleared (empty).
2. P-control: D2 keeps setting_id = I2.
3. I1 is intact in the target (same id, same alias).

## Self-probe notes
- Discriminating input: two datasources, only one tied to the moved integration; a clear-all or clear-nothing implementation fails Then 1 or 2.
- Datasource state is read through the datasource GET, independent of the PUT. The fixture does not precompute the cleared value: the initial setting_id is asserted by the case's own setup read.
- Gap: if a datasource cannot be created on local-docker without external credentials the case is reported blocked_by_env, never skipped silently.
- "Fail visibly" part of R-12 (the datasource errors on use) is not asserted: no source states the message.

## Obligation coverage
| obligation/part | oracle | boundary | Then | residual gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OB-9 cleared link | R-12 | datasource GET | 1 | visible failure on use not asserted |
| OB-9 control untouched | R-12 | datasource GET | 2 | none |
| OB-9 moved integration intact | R-12 | integration GET | 3 | none |
